config.source_preparation: Three new ordinary source initializations, 500 epochs; then one 900-epoch full-correct single-generator preparation per source using the existing forward-only v3 protocol. All four predictor arms freeze and share that prepared encoder, both original affine maps, and readout. This tests capacity conditional on a relation-trained encoder, not spontaneous discovery.
config.predictor: Frozen original affine first map plus two-layer residual. Identity versus GELU between identically sized Linear(128,256), Linear(256,128); identical initial weights and zero final layer. Both have exactly 65920 trainable parameters. Second operator is unchanged and never refitted.
config.loss: Correct frozen first-state output-distribution KD in all four arms, plus full-space first-state MSE divided by fixed correct-target per-coordinate variance. Wrong geometry uses a complete derangement preserving all three gold visible answers. No composite labels, states, losses, checkpoint selection, or early stopping in fitting.
config.primary_prediction: The nonlinear correct-minus-wrong collision AB accuracy advantage exceeds the corresponding linear advantage.
config.uncertainty: Paired two-way bootstrap of three source clusters and 128 shared collision pairs, 10000 draws. Per-source contrasts reported; only three independent source initializations, so intervals are descriptive and limited.
config.test_policy: All twelve fixed-budget predictor fits and all three frozen-source preparations must finish before any new compound test inference. Known-only validation curves do not select checkpoints. A failed known-only source gate is reported without dropping or replacing its seed.
config.novelty: Exclude both previously examined matrix test orbit sets from the entire new study. New train/validation/test whole-group orbits are disjoint. Historical training orbits can recur under newly initialized models; no global never-seen-input claim.
config.scope: Prospective matched-parameter first-operator capacity-by-correspondence intervention; single-step supervision only. Correct/wrong teacher outputs, starts, exposures, initialization, fixed second operator, encoder, readout and update schedules are identical within a source. Supports can overlap across sources. No claim that a three-gold-answer collision ceiling limits access to full logits or hidden states.

source_plan.supervision: Common forward-only e→a/e→b supervision; no inverse assumption for irreversible differentiation. All conditions share correct native CE/KD and generator-output KD, exact1024 anchors each epoch, and five native state queries. Only geometric pairing or geometry-space choice differs.
source_plan.output_space_scope: Information diagnostic; same encoder/native supervision/input exposures/epochs, smaller operators on full logits; operator parameter counts differ. It is not a capacity-matched causal control.
source_plan.legacy_permworld_scope: Completed PermWorld studies use bidirectional involution supervision and a transformer. They are version1, preserved as-is; not described as identical architecture/loss to new forward-only noninvertible-compatible version3.
source_plan.test_opening: After fixed900-epoch pilot passes known native/gen thresholds, finish all36 formal fits before evaluating compound test. No use of compound results for tuning or early stopping. Fixed900 epoch shared across both new domains.
source_plan.matrix_actions: A=[[0,1],[1,0]], B=[[0,-1],[1,-1]] inGL(2,F13); generated group has6 elements, A²=B³=e andABA=B². Ordinary task trace.
source_plan.polynomial_actions: Exact degree3 polynomials overF13; A translates by+1, B differentiates. AB=BA. Base/readout f(0), observed f(0),f(1),f′(0), missing f′(1).
source_plan.polynomial_splitting: Blocks by(c3, derivative discriminant) retain translation closure and one derivative. Audit all actually observed known paths against all test paths. Full semigroup-closure disjointness is impossible because D⁴ sends all cubics tozero. Collision/uncertainty block dependence must be reported.
source_plan.source_replication: Three independently pretrained sources per domain, reused in six adaptation repeats. Supports may overlap; source/train/validation/test path separation is audited.
source_plan.scope: Intervention study of specified mathematical relations; not spontaneous discovery, full group representation proof, or established output-independent mechanism.
source_plan.encoding: numeric_gelu: four centered/scaled scalar field coordinates, generic GELU MLP; no one-hot features and no group operations in the model.
source_plan.known_only_selection: Version2 one-hot/numeric encoding failed generator generalization (train99.8%, heldout7.8%). Scalar GELU selected before compound tests using separately reserved known pilot64 and confirmation128. No compound outcomes used for architecture selection. Polynomial shares matrix-selected architecture.
source_plan.execution: Two independent seeded fit processes; every36 fixed900-epoch fit completes before compound test opens.
source_plan.registration_scope: Registered after known-only source0/pilot architecture feasibility, before every new compound test and before all36 formal intervention fits. Source0/pilot reused exactly; three ordinary source seeds, six adaptations.
